dimension_policy.novelty: Only an informal O-overlap observation is recorded. Formal novelty classification remains the separate novelty comparator's responsibility.
dimension_policy.evidence_strength: No evidence-strength grade is assigned here. evidence_reference points only to the originating clean-worker artifact and quantitative/scope statements are preserved from it.
dimension_policy.decision_relevance: Judged against current O by mechanism fit, expected information value, implementation tractability, evaluation tractability, overlap with current mechanisms, and ability to resolve active uncertainty.

o_snapshot.main_commit_message: Checkpoint generation 12 at last durable native request
current_state: Generation 12 is checkpointed; unpublished local responses are non-authoritative.
The sole current immutable semantic request remains invoke-248450c08547af10470c50e6, revision-22-bound and unanswered in remote durable truth.

The active unit is a frozen held-out action-adherence comparison of the Context Kernel route versus a manifest-free control across stale authority, safe supersession, and path-disjoint advance scenarios.
O already has scoped Candidates, protected regression/rollback semantics, durable journals/tool traces, context manifests, evidence boundaries, and exact-scope negative-evidence policy.
O's objective is minimizing defensible expected elapsed time to genuine real-world AGI; independent production evidence is still absent and AGI remains unsupported.

highest_current_value_clusters: evaluation validity under adaptive sampling/search pressure, benchmark auditing, and environment-grounded verification
monitor-to-intervention causal utility: recovery versus disruption rather than detector accuracy alone
rollback/checkpoint semantics that distinguish recoverable state from compensable or irreversible external effects
context/memory admission and activation/adherence, especially authority/placement and task-native outcome labels
evaluator fidelity and effective independence rather than nominal judge count
matched test-time-compute and locked-outer-audit controls for persistent self-improvement
preserve-and-refine / local-repair action granularity under finite compute budgets
important_lower_immediacy: weight-training, spiking, expandable-ensemble, and hypergradient continual-learning mechanisms remain mostly indirect until O has a concrete trainable substrate or a bounded non-weight analogue
population-exchange cadence is useful for future O-internal population search but must not be fed back into clean independent exploration workers

continual_learning.o_fit: Label-independent statistical shift detection could inform future dynamic module/context admission, but the demonstrated mechanism creates and trains VAE/classifier experts rather than routing O's current symbolic/durable context.
continual_learning.decision_use: Retain as a bounded analogue for learned change detection only if O later evaluates dynamic skill/module creation; require capacity-growth controls.
continual_learning.scope: Image continual-learning streams including fuzzy boundaries; expert count does not equal task count and parameter growth can be very large.
continual_learning.uncertainty: No same-label agent-domain transfer, fixed-capacity matched control, or evidence that HSIC thresholds remain calibrated in O-like streams.

continual_learning.o_fit: Compressed prototype summaries plus bias-correcting hypergradients is conceptually relevant to summary-memory bias, but its operative intervention is per-parameter online training and class prototypes, absent from current O.
continual_learning.decision_use: Do not prioritize implementation now; preserve as a future training-substrate candidate and as evidence that summary memory can introduce systematic update bias.
continual_learning.scope: Task-free with respect to boundaries/task IDs but class-labeled vision streams; no raw replay, not literally zero durable statistics.
continual_learning.uncertainty: Transfer from gradient dynamics to O's artifact/context routing is analogy unless a matched non-weight formulation is tested.

continual_learning.o_fit: A fixed-budget short-term FIFO plus long-term distributional replay buffer directly informs O's unresolved durable-memory/context economics, while world-model training itself is not O's current substrate.
continual_learning.decision_use: Test the transferable allocation principle: reserve budget for recency/plasticity and long-term stability, sweep the split, and judge downstream action quality under fixed total memory/cost rather than assuming more retention is always better.
continual_learning.scope: DreamerV3 continual RL on Atari/CoinRun with fixed replay capacity; effects include world-model and actor/critic learning dynamics.
continual_learning.uncertainty: No direct O-style context-memory ablation; optimal buffer ratio is task/order dependent and no split dominates every metric.

cross_field.o_fit: O already values information gain and falsification, but its current evidence work can benefit from explicitly targeting uncertainty only where it changes downstream decisions rather than broad generic probing.
cross_field.decision_use: For ambiguous O mechanisms, choose the cheapest safe intervention that discriminates decision-relevant hypotheses and measure restoration/decision value, not generic observability.
cross_field.scope: Industrial MPC-X/depropanizer identification under operational constraints; the 0.0082 to 0.043 change is induced degradation, not the causal benefit size of MPC-X.
cross_field.uncertainty: Real-plant evidence lacks a clean randomized passive-learning comparison under matched disturbances; transfer from physical control is structural, not direct.

cross_field.o_fit: O has safe boundaries, durable checkpoints, fencing and recovery, but current generation-12 publication/checkpoint friction makes semantic side-effect-gated persistence and checkpoint granularity immediately decision-relevant.
cross_field.decision_use: Measure whether O can skip read-only/no-effect checkpoints, escalate persistence by actual effect scope, and overlap persistence with model/tool wait while preserving exact recovery correctness.
cross_field.scope: 2026 agent-sandbox preprint; >75% no recovery-relevant turns, up to 87% checkpoint-traffic reduction, 8% to 100% recovery correctness in reported workloads, <=1.9% execution overhead with injected crashes.
cross_field.uncertainty: Classifier false-negative/false-positive rates for recovery-relevant effects remain an open frontier; conservative full checkpoints may still be required at high-risk boundaries.

cross_field.o_fit: Could reduce O's trace/diagnostic overhead while preserving aggregate fault-localization evidence, but O does not yet appear to have the very high independent-run volume that makes extreme sparse sampling attractive.
cross_field.decision_use: Use only for high-volume repeated diagnostics with known inclusion probabilities; keep dense traces for rare/high-impact failures and final confirmation.
cross_field.scope: Software predicate instrumentation: about 13% overhead to about 0.5% at 1/1000 sampling in a case study, with 10k-20k-run sample-complexity caveat at 1/100.
cross_field.uncertainty: Rare O failures and low run counts can make sparse telemetry statistically inefficient or unsafe.

evaluation.o_fit: O currently spends scarce runtime on held-out comparisons and already needs exact evidence scope; valid group-sequential stopping can directly cut elapsed evaluation time without invalid repeated peeking.
evaluation.decision_use: Use predeclared margins/precision and alpha-spending or dependence-aware analogues to stop when effect/futility is resolved, while preserving a full-dataset path for near-ties.
evaluation.scope: 206 VLMs/31 multimodal benchmarks; roughly 15/30/50% samples for ±3/±2/±1.5 pp confidence widths, with >2 pp gaps often saving >=60% evaluation effort.
evaluation.uncertainty: Agent trajectories are dependent/clustered and may violate the source's simpler sample assumptions; multiple-comparison and stopping overhead require adaptation.

evaluation.o_fit: O already logs traces and exact failures, but distinguishing early recoverable errors from the first unrecoverable causal failure can materially improve Learn/repair targeting and avoid mis-credit assignment.
evaluation.decision_use: Attach explicit constraints and step-indexed violations, localize the earliest unrecoverable failure, and choose whole-trajectory versus localized judging by horizon/context length.
evaluation.scope: 115 failed trajectories across tau-bench, Flash and Magentic-One; strongest gains are diagnosis metrics, not end-to-end recovery success.
evaluation.uncertainty: Generated constraints can themselves be wrong; long-context gains weaken and there is no calibrated abstention guarantee.

evaluation.o_fit: O already prefers mechanically judged action traces over verbal claims; active environment re-execution and correctable-versus-irrecoverable labels directly strengthen that evaluation boundary.
evaluation.decision_use: Where tools permit, verify process states against environment invariants and distinguish recoverable errors from fatal ones; evaluate verifiers under the actual Best-of-N/search pressure used downstream.
evaluation.scope: Agentic data-analysis tasks with task-specific environment-grounded PRM; reported annotation agreement 86%, kappa .83 and selection gains under tested policies.
evaluation.uncertainty: Task-specific training and imperfect downstream judges confound portability; need domain-transfer and re-execution contribution ablations.

evaluation.o_fit: If O uses probabilistic process judges for routing, abstention or budget allocation, their scores must be calibrated against the actual executor/policy rather than treated as portable probabilities.
evaluation.decision_use: Calibrate only when probabilities drive resource or stop/continue decisions; keep ranking-only uses separate and re-calibrate after executor/model changes.
evaluation.scope: Math PRMs with policy-conditioned rollout success probabilities; large Brier/AdaCE gains and compute-allocation savings, not tool-agent evidence.
evaluation.uncertainty: Direct transfer to repository/tool trajectories is untested and pure ranking may not need calibration.

evaluation.o_fit: O already has fail-closed/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE outcomes; unanimity-with-abstention provides external evidence for reliability-first labeling but also exposes its large coverage cost.
evaluation.decision_use: Use abstention only where false acceptance cost dominates; report precision/NPV jointly with coverage and avoid treating unanimity as free accuracy.
evaluation.scope: Computer-use reward evaluation with 272 trajectory and 346 step annotations; PRM unanimity precision/NPV 81.7/85.1 but recall/specificity 48.9/24.4.
evaluation.uncertainty: Small, short-trajectory benchmark and correlated judge errors can make nominal ensemble diversity misleading.

failure_evidence.o_fit: O's Candidate acceptance depends on held-out benchmarks; same-trajectory ranking reversals after task auditing show benchmark composition can change decisions without any model-policy change.
failure_evidence.decision_use: Pin audited task manifests and report ranking sensitivity to task validity/filtering before using a benchmark as a decisive acceptance gate.
failure_evidence.scope: AgentSuite stored trajectories; Filtering changes denominator without reruns and reverses several pairwise/local and overall rankings.
failure_evidence.uncertainty: Filtering is an audit policy, not proof every dropped task is invalid; repaired-task reruns are a distinct Fixed condition.

failure_evidence.o_fit: O's real-world/external evidence standard requires longitudinal comparability; live-web task churn and browser/OS/region sensitivity can otherwise masquerade as capability change.
failure_evidence.decision_use: Bind environment version, task IDs, browser/system/region and dataset revision into external-evidence provenance, and avoid comparing scores across unpinned live states.
failure_evidence.scope: Online-Mind2Web/WebCanvas; 36/300 tasks replaced in one maintenance event and same named planner shows large success variation across configurations.
failure_evidence.uncertainty: The maintenance event mixes invalidity and CAPTCHA; configuration table is not randomized paired causal evidence and same-task temporal drift remains unresolved.

failure_evidence.o_fit: O is cost/elapsed-time sensitive and should not assume greater inference effort monotonically improves agent outcomes.
failure_evidence.decision_use: Treat reasoning effort as a configuration to measure under matched scaffold/task/cost, and allocate extra inference only when marginal outcome value is demonstrated.
failure_evidence.scope: HAL reports 21,730 rollouts; 21/36 matched settings showed no accuracy improvement at higher reasoning effort, including ties.
failure_evidence.uncertainty: Provider reasoning controls are not a common compute unit and exact per-cell deltas/costs were not extracted in the clean artifact.

failure_evidence.o_fit: O's current active experiment is explicitly about authority/supersession and action adherence; byte-identical errors becoming much more explicitly correctable after role relabeling is directly relevant to Context Kernel representation and inherited-state handling.
failure_evidence.decision_use: When testing correction/supersession, vary authority/role representation as a controlled factor and score downstream actions separately from explicit verbal error flagging.
failure_evidence.scope: 13 model-domain cells, n=30 paired tasks; explicit correction changes +23 to +93 pp in reported comparisons, not a deployed-agent final-answer improvement claim.
failure_evidence.uncertainty: Requires localized wrong claims and can increase trust in untrusted external roles; final correctness and unsafe acceptance remain separate outcomes.

long_horizon.o_fit: O has monitoring, regression gates and rollback concepts, but the clean evidence shows high detector AUROC/F1 can coexist with catastrophic end-to-end intervention loss; this directly challenges metric-only monitor acceptance.
long_horizon.decision_use: Evaluate any monitor together with its actual intervention using failure prevalence p, recovery r, disruption d and final success delta; reject monitors that predict well but damage trajectories.
long_horizon.scope: HotPotQA/GAIA/ALFWorld intervention study; some base-agent/task regimes degrade by 25-30 pp while ALFWorld sees only small positive deltas.
long_horizon.uncertainty: Thresholds and p/r/d are deployment specific; perfect prediction still has limited upside when the executor cannot absorb correction.

long_horizon.o_fit: O already has deterministic invariants and exact readback; clean external evidence indicates such checks can reduce disruptive false alarms and materially improve live repair when coupled to rollback/rerun.
long_horizon.decision_use: Prefer deterministic/task-native checks where possible, measure learned-monitor cold-transfer separately, recalibrate per deployment, and compare repair to resampling under matched cost.
long_horizon.scope: Primary abstract reports live repair recovery 45% vs 16% resampling and task success 52% to 73%; learned monitor cold AUROC .527 vs .885 after recalibration.
long_horizon.uncertainty: Abstract-level evidence for some figures; deployment/framework details and independent replication remain limited.

long_horizon.o_fit: O has rollback and CAS semantics, but external-world actions need an explicit distinction between idempotent, reversible, compensable and irreversible effects; internal checkpoint restore cannot undo all world state.
long_horizon.decision_use: Record effect class before commit, gate X-class irreversible actions, include compensation cost/residue in K-class recovery, and choose rollback near the earliest conflicting irreversible/compensable effect when assumptions hold.
long_horizon.scope: Streaming-agent theory plus StreamBench DeepSeek-V3 n=1008; Revision Absorber reportedly matches full-restart quality while wasting 14.6x fewer completed steps.
long_horizon.uncertainty: Theory assumptions may not hold for entangled tool effects; compensation quality for real email/API/database actions needs direct measurement.

multi_agent.o_fit: Selective exchange cadence could matter if O later runs semi-independent candidate populations, but current O is not primarily bottlenecked on island-model population search.
multi_agent.decision_use: If population search is introduced, make exchange cadence/size/acceptance controlled variables and preserve semi-independent lineages; never feed this comparator judgment back into clean exploration workers.
multi_agent.scope: EvoDiverse equation discovery/circle packing with fixed budgets; periods 2-5 outperform 10-20 in one sweep and k>5 gives no observed gain.
multi_agent.uncertainty: No universal cadence; task landscape, generation cost and evaluation latency determine optimum.

multi_agent.o_fit: O selects among candidate mechanisms under scarce evaluation budget; a cheap fitness estimate with rho=.11 to deep ranking is direct evidence that low-fidelity screens can mis-select champions.
multi_agent.decision_use: Use cheap evaluation for triage, then escalate selection/archive decisions to higher-fidelity tests when uncertainty or decision impact is high; compare under total-cost budgets.
multi_agent.scope: FAMOU adversarial strategy evolution; removing deep evaluation is the largest reported single ablation drop (-26%, p=.002), but main comparisons are equal-iteration rather than equal-compute.
multi_agent.uncertainty: Single-run component ablation and interacting components prevent assigning a universal fidelity threshold.

multi_agent.o_fit: O's evidence gates could be falsely strengthened by nominally multiple correlated LLM judges; measured effective vote count is a directly actionable evaluator-design risk.
multi_agent.decision_use: Measure error correlation/effective panel size on held-out decisions and spend extra budget on independent evidence channels or stronger verification rather than more correlated votes.
multi_agent.scope: Nine judges on 1000 ChaosNLI-MNLI items yield n_eff about 2.18; RewardBench n_eff about 1.99 and majority can underperform the best single judge.
multi_agent.uncertainty: Classification/preference tasks are not identical to open-ended O candidate evaluation; the proposed n_eff/k warning threshold is heuristic.

neuroscience.o_fit: SAL addresses biologically local weight-credit assignment, whereas current O is an orchestration/context/evidence system without a trainable spiking feedback substrate.
neuroscience.decision_use: Do not divert current O effort; retain for future trainable-substrate research only.
neuroscience.scope: Deep SymmNet with SAL only on fully connected feedback; SAL trails BP by 4.2 pp CIFAR-10, 0.6 pp Fashion-MNIST and 2.0 pp SVHN; no exact independent replication.
neuroscience.uncertainty: Raw five-seed sweep artifacts are not committed and conv layers use FA rather than SAL for non-BP algorithms.

neuroscience.o_fit: Grow/reuse/prune modularity has a conceptual parallel to O's recursive skills, but the demonstrated causal object is spiking-network modules with explicit task boundaries and gradient/evolutionary updates.
neuroscience.decision_use: Retain as a future modular-training candidate; do not treat neuroscience inspiration as evidence for changing O's current Skill-in-Skill architecture.
neuroscience.scope: Split CIFAR-100/TinyImageNet with explicit sequential task segmentation; energy values are analytical estimates, implementation availability unresolved, no independent replication.
neuroscience.uncertainty: Transfer to language-agent modular routing is untested and would otherwise be analogy-driven.

open_source.o_fit: O's active unit tests Context Kernel action adherence; public code shows memory systems differ in retrieval volume, abstraction, prompt authority/placement, utilization discretion and outcome-label quality, not merely whether a similarity gate exists.
open_source.decision_use: Factor context experiments across abstraction, retrieval count, authority/placement, optional use and task-native label fidelity; include no-memory fallback and negative-transfer outcomes rather than post-hoc causal stories.
open_source.scope: ReasoningBank SWE path is online sequential, forced top-1 when nonempty and uses an LLM induction-status judge rather than official SWE outcome; Memento defaults to top-8 concrete cases/plans with no absolute threshold.
open_source.uncertainty: Public third-party benchmark adapters/per-run artifacts do not isolate which component caused observed downstream differences.

open_source.o_fit: Separate producer output from verifier/reviewer admission into durable truth closely matches O's Candidate/evidence boundaries and is directly relevant to preventing success-shaped artifacts from contaminating persistent state.
open_source.decision_use: Treat reviewer verdict as an evidence gate, not truth by authority; use task-native scorers where available, preserve rejected routes as scoped negative evidence, and trace mechanical enforcement rather than prompt-only policy.
open_source.scope: Argus full-runtime results combine roles, routing, durable state and verification; ~78% vs ~59% SWE-Bench Pro at 1.41x tokens is not a causal ablation of the gate alone.
open_source.uncertainty: Need code-level trace of enforcement/rollback and matched component ablation before attributing full-runtime gains to reviewer gating.

reasoning.o_fit: O already preserves incumbents and branches Candidates; compiler-guided exploration/refinement/resampling supplies quantitative support for choosing among fresh branch, repair and preserve-best under budget rather than destructively accepting every refinement.
reasoning.decision_use: Use realized verifier feedback and stagnation to decide when to refine versus restart, preserve the best verified state, and cost-normalize comparison calls separately from expensive generation/action calls.
reasoning.scope: Lean whole-proof search; +12.8 pp average pass within pass@32 and -21.9% LLM calls in the reported setup; no tactic-level semantic diversity.
reasoning.uncertainty: Pairwise progress judge is an LLM and not proven calibrated; theorem-proving transfer to repository work needs matched tests.

reasoning.o_fit: O's use of LLM-mediated comparisons/judges is a critical validity surface; severe position bias in formal-proof preference ranking shows generation strength does not imply evaluator reliability.
reasoning.decision_use: For any pairwise LLM judge, run swapped-order consistency/calibration tests and prefer verifier/process-derived progress signals where possible.
reasoning.scope: FormalRewardBench 250 Lean correct-vs-incorrect pairs; best frontier pairwise accuracy 59.8%, with some models showing extreme first/second-position gaps.
reasoning.uncertainty: Finished correct-vs-incorrect proof ranking is not identical to comparing two partial failed states for repairability.

reasoning.o_fit: O performs scoped repository changes and rollback; typed local repairs can reduce destructive edits and cost when failures are localized.
reasoning.decision_use: Expose bounded local-edit actions before whole rewrite/restart when constraints permit, and compare solved-state coverage per token/cost.
reasoning.scope: BlueprintTrace 142 controlled Lean failures; typed edits 104/142, patches 109/142, rewrites 104/142; patches 1.30x and rewrites 2.06x typed cost per solved state.
reasoning.uncertainty: Controlled blueprint failures are not a generic software-repair benchmark and typed interfaces can miss non-local failures.

reasoning.o_fit: Preserve solved substructure and refine only failed dependency regions closely matches O's logical-unit/durable-state philosophy and can inform hierarchical repair routing.
reasoning.decision_use: Keep verified subunits immutable when possible, diagnose failed nodes, and choose local repair, graph/decomposition refinement or restart by failure type and cost.
reasoning.scope: Lean blueprint DAG prover with up to 16 internal refinement iterations; pipeline-level pass@1 is not one model sample and compute must be normalized.
reasoning.uncertainty: Theorem-proving-specific tools and internal budgets limit direct effect-size transfer.

reasoning.o_fit: O's routing can benefit from realized failure/error diversity as a decision signal rather than lexical/proposal diversity alone, especially under finite evaluation budgets.
reasoning.decision_use: Compare compiler/tool error diversity, repairability and measured future cost as routing features; preserve version provenance and test calibration before adoption.
reasoning.scope: Current v3 headline 28.9% average budget reduction at approximately preserved accuracy; detailed feature/noise ablations are from an earlier public version with 25.8% headline.
reasoning.uncertainty: Do not silently transfer earlier-version ablation numbers to v3; oracle gap remains large.

scientist_agents.o_fit: EviGraph's deterministic contract validation, transactional mutation/rollback and evidence-readiness guard strongly align with O's evidence-bound Candidate lifecycle and provide a scientist-agent package-level external comparison.
scientist_agents.decision_use: Use as external support for deterministic evidence-chain enforcement, but do not attribute gains separately to graph, rollback, regeneration or memory without ablation.
scientist_agents.scope: Matched qwen-3.6-plus backbone/sandbox/per-experiment time; Overall 86.45% vs 60.37% strongest compared system, CSR 37.85% vs 27%; total compute/hardware/seeds not fully frozen.
scientist_agents.uncertainty: Authors explicitly say conventional component ablation is hard; reliability metrics still include LLM-mediated extraction/judgment and CSR remains low in absolute terms.

scientist_agents.o_fit: ACRA cleanly separates syntax/executability from semantic/physical fidelity, directly relevant to O's rule that generated artifacts or successful tool syntax cannot stand in for real-world correctness.
scientist_agents.decision_use: Require staged validation from parse/contract success through source consistency and environment/task-native execution, and measure feasibility-classification errors rather than trusting procedure generation alone.
scientist_agents.scope: Chemistry procedure translation/execution; Procedure-Agent classification 67.5% on 39 manually checked procedures; 150-procedure syntax validity 99.33% versus 94.67% later semantic/physical validation.
scientist_agents.uncertainty: Critique-agent ablation is only eight procedures and exact bar values were not recovered; chemistry DSL maturity may not transfer to other domains.

scientist_agents.o_fit: O's strict AGI/scientific-evidence standard makes evaluator validity and resource-quality confounding first-class concerns; automated acceptance with unsupported claims is direct negative evidence against judge-only scientific validation.
scientist_agents.decision_use: Use automated review as dimension-specific/coarse screening, retain expert/task-native verification for validity-critical claims, and never infer system quality monotonically from token/cost spend.
scientist_agents.scope: MLReplicate six heterogeneous autonomous-research systems; 10/37 automated-review accepts, 59% of accepts contained fabricated/unsupported claims under human review, overall Pearson r=.29/Spearman rho=.40.
scientist_agents.uncertainty: Systems differ in models/tools/interfaces and manuscripts are not backed by independent validation of every underlying experiment; resource comparisons are observational, not causal.

self_improvement.o_fit: O repeatedly proposes/evaluates Candidates; only 55/388 byte-distinct validation bests and validation-to-released-test failures show why persistent self-improvement must be treated as sparse adaptive search, not monotonic learning.
self_improvement.decision_use: Track proposal count, selection frequency and fresh-test disagreement; require released/disjoint evidence for persistent updates and separate extra-inference gains from durable adaptation gains.
self_improvement.scope: 42 feedback runs, 14 model-benchmark settings; 11 validation-selected evolved skills, 9 improve released test; persistent gains vary strongly by benchmark.
self_improvement.uncertainty: No direct greedy-vs-anytime-valid-vs-familywise acceptance comparison or statistical false-commit rate.
self_improvement.provenance_note: Artifact-qualified key used because source-local C8 can collide with older clean worker numbering.

self_improvement.o_fit: O needs to know whether a durable mechanism truly adds reusable capability or merely packages test-time rediscovery; matched compute and disjoint-task controls directly resolve that ambiguity.
self_improvement.decision_use: For persistent O skill/harness updates, compare against equal-budget parallel sampling/refinement and disjoint held-out tasks before claiming reusable self-improvement.
self_improvement.scope: Terminal-Bench 2.1 K=5; without unit tests Harness Evolution average 67.4 vs direct 68.2, and disjoint split gives only +0.6 average; one benchmark/two-run averages.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Does not reject harness evolution universally; value is task/model/scaffold dependent.

self_improvement.o_fit: O explicitly treats evaluation as fallible; if an evaluator itself adapts, downstream reward cannot validate it, making a locked outer audit directly relevant to any future self-improving judge.
self_improvement.decision_use: Keep an audit channel inaccessible to proposer and evolving evaluator, test evaluator validity directly, and treat Goodhart repair as a separate acceptance axis from candidate performance.
self_improvement.scope: Three domains/small locked sets; code-generation metric agreement +0.21, p=.014; removing anchor guards collapses to always-pass while downstream skill training can still appear useful.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Small held-out sets, three seeds and teacher-family dependence; no proof of indefinite calibration.

self_improvement.o_fit: O's exact current held-out unit tests action adherence, not just context availability; the clean evidence decomposes durable improvement into artifact quality, activation/load, adherence and final outcome and shows weak models can fail mainly at activation/adherence.
self_improvement.decision_use: Preserve the current action-adherence experiment and extend future persistent-skill evaluation with separate activation, adherence and outcome measurements before spending more capability on the improver.
self_improvement.scope: Seven LLMs on SWE-bench Verified, MCP-Atlas and SkillsBench; evolver spread <=3.1 pp while harness-load rate is about 25% for Qwen3-32B versus ~96% for strong models.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Three benchmark substrates/fixed protocol; flat evolver scaling does not imply proposer quality is never important.

self_improvement.o_fit: O combines durable context, skills and episodes; paired longitudinal evidence that skill-only can beat memory-only and combined persistence is directly relevant to avoiding additive-context assumptions.
self_improvement.decision_use: Ablate persistence substrates separately and together under matched cost/variance, including concise procedural skill versus episodic memory and feedback format; measure interference rather than assuming more memory is better.
self_improvement.scope: FinEvo-Bench 120 professional finance tasks; evolving conditions +9.33 to +19.37 points with lower compliance issues, but exact full-table cells remain pending primary verification.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Finance workflows favor reusable procedures; aggregate abstract-level ablations lack all absolute cells/variance/cost details.
